## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --lib` passes (in `src-tauri/`)

- [ ] If `vendor/` was touched: the change is recorded in `vendor/mupdf/PATCHES.md` (or next to the mupdf-sys patch) and `third_party/mupdf/MODIFICATIONS.md`
